item.title: Beyond the pilot: A command-level guide to co-responder programs that last
item.description: Strong co-responder programs collapse when authority fragments and protections disappear. This guide outlines what chiefs must secure to make them last

item.title: Entry for emergency aid does not require probable cause
item.description: The emergency-aid exception is neither a Terry stop nor a criminal investigation. It has its own standard: objective reasonableness based on the totality of circumstances

item.title: Ex-Md. PD chief convicted of arson, sentenced to 55 years in prison
item.description: Former Laurel Police Chief David Crawford is already serving consecutive life sentences for arsons committed in Howard County between 2011 and 2020

item.title: Ohio brothers sell first responder T-shirts to raise money for children's cancer research
item.description: 2BUnited, founded by Jacob and Carter with guidance and support from their parents, partnered with Briarwood Products to raise money for St. Jude. Children's Research Hospital

item.title: Bomb detonates during evidence processing, 2 Colo. bomb squad officers burned
item.description: One Pueblo Police officer sustained first- and second-degree burns; the second officer suffered first-, second- and third-degree burns and was transported to a burn unit

item.title: BWC: Suspected bank robber points replica gun at Calif. officers before fatal OIS
item.description: Video shows the suspect pulling the gun, which was later found to be an imitation firearm, from his waistband and pointing it at officers as they fled on foot

item.title: Md. sheriffs vow to keep working with ICE after governor signs bill forbidding 287(g) partnerships
item.description: “No politician ... is going to tell me that I can’t communicate with another [LE] agency on matters of public safety in my community,” Carroll County Sheriff James DeWees said
